answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through hardware attestation, requiring identities to submit cryptographic quotes from secure enclaves. Ingress passes an admission jetty that restricts unverified peers to a network island. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of acquiring physical silicon per identity rather than multiplying across a porous karst of virtual hosts. However, this mechanism centralizes trust in chipmakers and cannot prevent hardware side-channel exploits.
